I saved this to EngramDB. The new memory replaces the old one, which said to push a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag on main and let CI publish. From now on, releases will be cut with `make release`.

There's no Makefile with a `release` target in this repo right now. If it lives somewhere else or hasn't been merged yet, that's fine. But anyone who runs `make release` here today will get an error until it's added.
